name: Nantes public car park availability (Naolib)
short: Live free places in Nantes public car parks. Free, no key, ODbL.
summary: Nantes Metropole's open data portal serves a keyless Opendatasoft API with real-time availability of public car parks in Nantes: car park id and name, status code, available places, operating capacity, a fill threshold, address, coordinates and a timestamp. On 2026-11-08 the dataset held 27 car parks (for example Tour Bretagne, 453 of 643 available) stamped within minutes.

tasks: free places in a Nantes car park now
whether a Nantes car park is full
list Nantes public car parks with address and coordinates

coverage.notes: 27 public car parks on 2026-11-08. Status codes are numeric and not explained in the records read.

delivery.basis: Live GET 2026-11-08: grp_horodatage was minutes old.

latency.notes: Per-record grp_horodatage field; update interval not stated.

freshness.notes: Per-record grp_horodatage field; update interval not stated.

licensing.summary: Nantes Metropole lists the dataset under the Open Database License (ODbL 1.0): copy, adapt and commercial use are allowed with credit, share-alike for adapted databases and keeping the licence. AI training is not specifically addressed beyond ODbL itself.

human.unknown: Not applicable: automated systems, not people.

application.unknown: No signing or attestation from source to API is documented.

camera.unknown: Not applicable: no imagery in this feed.

corroboration.unknown: Nothing documented independently confirms individual readings.

time.unknown: Device clock checks are not documented.
